summary: Iteration 168: Verified Dedup + Auto-Merge fixes for candidate profiles. All 15 tests passed (100%). Tested recruiter contact filtering, email/phone dedup, auto-merge engine, CTC merge rules, optional naukri fields, and data quality sanity checks.

minor.issue: Emails containing @example.com and @test.com are blocked by design - tests needed to use @testmail.org domain

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Recruiter contact filtering: @vhc.in domain emails correctly blocked, recruiter's own email stripped from captures
✅ Email dedup: When email matches and names are similar, profile is updated (not duplicated)
✅ Phone dedup: When phone matches and names are similar, profile is updated (not duplicated)
✅ Auto-merge engine: Implemented in services/candidate_merge.py with find_merge_candidate(), merge_profiles(), log_merge_audit()
✅ Auto-merge is a FALLBACK that triggers when all existing dedup checks fail but 2/3 of (name, email, phone) still match
✅ CTC merge rule: Higher value kept ONLY if <= ₹20 Cr cap (CTC_MAX = 200_000_000)
✅ Skills merge: Union of skills from both profiles (capped at 50)
✅ Experience/Education merge: Longer list is kept
✅ naukri_profile_id and naukri_profile_url are now Optional[str] = None in models/extension.py
✅ Location word boundary: 'Goal-oriented' does NOT produce location='Goa'
✅ POST /api/extension/ai-extract returns profile data for well-structured profiles
seed_data_creation: Test candidates created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 168 verified the Dedup + Auto-Merge engine. Key findings: 1) Recruiter contact filtering works - @vhc.in emails blocked, recruiter's own email/phone stripped. 2) Email/phone dedup works when names are similar (uses _names_are_similar which checks first word match). 3) Auto-merge is a FALLBACK that only triggers when ALL existing dedup checks fail (naukri_id, name+source, email, phone) but 2/3 of (name, email, phone) still match via fuzzy name matching. 4) CTC merge keeps higher value only if <= ₹20 Cr. 5) Skills are merged as union. 6) naukri_profile_id and naukri_profile_url are now Optional. IMPORTANT: Test emails must NOT use @example.com or @test.com domains as they are blocked by the capture endpoint.
